answer: Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, re-queued for a second panel, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. The vertex holds work receipts rather than names, so the basalt of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the spiral of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work.
